require 'net/http'
require 'uri'
require 'base64'
require 'digest'
require 'securerandom'
require 'json'
require 'logger'

module AuthProxy
  class CircuitBreaker
    STATES = [:closed, :open, :half_open].freeze
    
    attr_reader :state, :failure_count, :last_failure_time
    
    def initialize(threshold: 5, timeout: 30, logger: Logger.new(STDOUT))
      @threshold = threshold
      @timeout = timeout
      @state = :closed
      @failure_count = 0
      @last_failure_time = nil
      @mutex = Mutex.new
      @logger = logger
    end
    
    def call(&block)
      case @state
      when :open
        if Time.now - @last_failure_time >= @timeout
          try_half_open(&block)
        else
          raise CircuitOpenError, "Circuit breaker is open"
        end
      when :half_open
        try_half_open(&block)
      when :closed
        try_request(&block)
      end
    end
    
    private
    
    def try_half_open(&block)
      @mutex.synchronize { @state = :half_open }
      result = block.call
      @mutex.synchronize do
        @state = :closed
        @failure_count = 0
      end
      result
    rescue => e
      record_failure
      raise
    end
    
    def try_request(&block)
      result = block.call
      result
    rescue => e
      record_failure
      raise
    end
    
    def record_failure
      @mutex.synchronize do
        @failure_count += 1
        @last_failure_time = Time.now
        if @failure_count >= @threshold
          @state = :open
          @logger.warn("Circuit breaker opened after #{@failure_count} failures")
        end
      end
    end
  end
  
  class CircuitOpenError < StandardError; end
  
  class NtlmAuthenticator
    NTLM_SIGNATURE = "NTLMSSP\x00"
    
    def initialize(domain:, backend_url:, circuit_breaker:)
      @domain = domain
      @backend_url = backend_url
      @circuit_breaker = circuit_breaker
      @session_store = {}
      @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
    end
    
    def authenticate(request_env)
      auth_header = request_env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION']
      return challenge_response unless auth_header
      
      scheme, token = auth_header.split(' ', 2)
      return challenge_response unless scheme&.downcase == 'ntlm'
      
      ntlm_message = Base64.decode64(token)
      msg_type = extract_message_type(ntlm_message)
      
      case msg_type
      when 1
        handle_type1(ntlm_message, request_env)
      when 3
        handle_type3(ntlm_message, request_env)
      else
        [401, {'WWW-Authenticate' => 'NTLM'}, ['Invalid NTLM message']]
      end
    end
    
    private
    
    def extract_message_type(message)
      return nil unless message.start_with?(NTLM_SIGNATURE)
      message[8..11].unpack1('V')
    end
    
    def handle_type1(negotiate_msg, request_env)
      session_id = SecureRandom.hex(16)
      
      challenge = generate_challenge_from_backend(negotiate_msg, session_id)
      
      if challenge
        request_env['rack.session'] ||= {}
        request_env['rack.session'][:ntlm_session] = session_id
        encoded = Base64.strict_encode64(challenge)
        [401, {'WWW-Authenticate' => "NTLM #{encoded}"}, ['']]
      else
        challenge_response
      end
    end
    
    def handle_type3(auth_msg, request_env)
      session_id = request_env.dig('rack.session', :ntlm_session)
      return challenge_response unless session_id
      
      result = validate_with_backend(auth_msg, session_id)
      
      if result[:authenticated]
        request_env['rack.session'].delete(:ntlm_session)
        [200, {'Content-Type' => 'application/json'}, 
         [JSON.generate({user: result[:username], domain: @domain})]]
      else
        challenge_response
      end
    end
    
    def generate_challenge_from_backend(negotiate_msg, session_id)
      @circuit_breaker.call do
        uri = URI.parse("#{@backend_url}/ntlm/negotiate")
        http = Net::HTTP.new(uri.host, uri.port)
        http.open_timeout = 5
        http.read_timeout = 5
        
        request = Net::HTTP::Post.new(uri.path)
        request['Content-Type'] = 'application/octet-stream'
        request['X-Session-Id'] = session_id
        request['X-Forwarded-Proto'] = 'ntlm'
        request.body = negotiate_msg
        
        response = http.request(request)
        
        if response.code == '200'
          @session_store[session_id] = {
            challenge_sent: true,
            timestamp: Time.now,
            connection: build_connection_token(http, session_id)
          }
          response.body
        else
          nil
        end
      end
    rescue CircuitOpenError => e
      @logger.error("Backend unavailable: #{e.message}")
      nil
    end
    
    def validate_with_backend(auth_msg, session_id)
      session_data = @session_store[session_id]
      return {authenticated: false} unless session_data&.dig(:challenge_sent)
      
      @circuit_breaker.call do
        uri = URI.parse("#{@backend_url}/ntlm/authenticate")
        http = Net::HTTP.new(uri.host, uri.port)
        http.open_timeout = 5
        http.read_timeout = 5
        
        request = Net::HTTP::Post.new(uri.path)
        request['Content-Type'] = 'application/octet-stream'
        request['X-Session-Id'] = session_id
        request['X-Connection-Token'] = session_data[:connection]
        request.body = auth_msg
        
        response = http.request(request)
        @session_store.delete(session_id)
        
        if response.code == '200'
          {authenticated: true, username: extract_username(auth_msg)}
        else
          {authenticated: false}
        end
      end
    rescue CircuitOpenError => e
      @logger.error("Backend unavailable: #{e.message}")
      {authenticated: false}
    end
    
    def build_connection_token(http, session_id)
      # Bind authentication to the session for relay protection
      raw = "#{session_id}:#{@backend_url}"
      Base64.strict_encode64(raw)
    end
    
    def extract_username(type3_msg)
      return 'unknown' unless type3_msg.length > 36
      domain_len = type3_msg[28..29].unpack1('v')
      domain_offset = type3_msg[32..35].unpack1('V')
      user_len = type3_msg[36..37].unpack1('v')
      user_offset = type3_msg[40..43].unpack1('V')
      
      if user_offset && user_len && user_offset + user_len <= type3_msg.length
        type3_msg[user_offset, user_len].force_encoding('UTF-16LE').encode('UTF-8') rescue 'unknown'
      else
        'unknown'
      end
    end
    
    def challenge_response
      [401, {'WWW-Authenticate' => 'NTLM'}, ['Authentication required']]
    end
  end
  
  class Middleware
    def initialize(app, domain:, backend_url:)
      @app = app
      @circuit_breaker = CircuitBreaker.new(threshold: 3, timeout: 60)
      @authenticator = NtlmAuthenticator.new(
        domain: domain,
        backend_url: backend_url,
        circuit_breaker: @circuit_breaker
      )
    end
    
    def call(env)
      if requires_auth?(env)
        result = @authenticator.authenticate(env)
        return result unless result[0] == 200
        env['REMOTE_USER'] = JSON.parse(result[2].first)['user']
      end
      @app.call(env)
    end
    
    private
    
    def requires_auth?(env)
      !env['PATH_INFO'].start_with?('/health', '/public')
    end
  end
end
